messages:
nina: noticed an nvme write latency spike in us-west2 blocking GPU attaches, backlog ~18 GPUs :grimacing:
infra-bot: [ALERT] nvme_write_latency region=us-west2 nodes=gnode-uw2-88,90,95 current=32ms threshold=25ms
tom: any kubelet AttachVolume errors or firmware noise in dmesg?
nina: mostly AttachVolume timeouts and a few 'nvme0: I/O CRC error' lines. saw a big cleanup sweep at 04:22 UTC against ephemeral=cleanup
carlos: can we avoid a full pause — prefer reducing concurrency and chunk size so cleaner yields to attaches
leah: safer quick defaults: CLEANER_PARALLEL=4 and MAX_DELETE_BYTES=536870912, add yield_on_attach flag if available
nina: applying quick patch to daemonset in us-west2, rolling update to 5 nodes now
tom: paste commands so I can mirror in eu-west if needed
nina: ran: `kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/ephemeral-cleaner CLEANER_PARALLEL=4 --context=us-west2` and `kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/ephemeral-cleaner MAX_DELETE_BYTES=536870912 --context=us-west2`
infra-bot: [METRIC] us-west2 nvme_write_latency 1m=30ms 5m=28ms 15m=14ms
carlos: early recovery looks promising. ETA to clear current backlog? if >1h we might need to delay noncritical GPU jobs or shift capacity to eu-west
leah: estimate 25-70m depending on tail latency. recommend auto-throttle rule: if nvme_write_latency>25ms AND attach_backlog>5 then reduce cleaner parallelism to 2
nina: filed INFRA-3341 "cleaner: attach-aware throttling" assigned to eng-infra (nina/carlos/tom). attaching graphs and dmesg excerpts
tom: will add canary rollout + rollback script to the patch
infra-bot: [ACTION] Created INFRA-3341 with links to graphs
nina: monitoring — current 1m nvme write latency 18ms, attach backlog 3. will observe 60m then close unless it regresses
carlos: capture GPU-minute cost delta in the ticket; rough ballpark ~45 gpu-minutes/hr if we hit sustained attaches failing
leah: postmortem items: safer defaults for cleaner, attach-sensitivity metrics, canary for cleaner env changes
nina: thanks team :thumbsup: closing thread unless regression
